content: Vector Admission Triad progress from ChatGPT relay conversation, May 24 2026. Gemini v3 for prompt_source_tokens landed as PROVISIONAL rather than admitted. The record used granular per-test verdicts: Fetch Determinism conditional, Semantic Delta conditional, Poison Test conditional. All eight capture-surface fields were named: raw source, byte/token range, tokenizer name/version, normalization rules, source artifact hash, run id plus timestamp, producer/source node, and exclusions/redactions. Three ADMITTED-transition items remain: specify the PII masking implementation; expand producer_node to include human-relay and cross-model-bridge patterns; define OCR/extraction hash order and extraction engine versioning. Future instances should retrieve this before advancing prompt_source_tokens from PROVISIONAL to ADMITTED.
